column3: Travel to Tyras Camp and take the path north-east. Cross the stick trap and dig beside the stone at the far side of the pool.
From the Observatory go east towards Tree Gnome Village. Find the lone willow by the river and dig on its south-west side.
From the general store walk west to the two ponds and dig on the narrow strip between them.
Use the Karamja lodestone. Walk to the dungeon entrance south-west of Brimhaven and dig just south of it, outside.
From Lumbridge Castle head into the swamp to the adventurers' camp where Lost City starts. Dig within the camp.
From Port Sarim go south-west past the church on the way to the ice cave. Dig near the cave entrance on the surface.
From Lumbridge go south into the swamp to the Nexus. Stand one tile north of its northern pillar and dig.
Use fairy ring DKP, then head north towards the fishing shore. Dig on the seaweed where Tiadeche fishes.
From the Tirannwn lodestone take the north-west trail over the leaf trap. Turn south-west to the stick trap and check the marked square beyond it.

column2: Moss Giant Island, west of Brimhaven
column3: Go to Brimhaven's west coast. Cross the agility obstacle to the moss giants and dig on the high ground in the middle of the island.
Go east from Yanille to the coastal islands. Reach the island with jungle spiders and dig at the highlighted position.
From Al Kharid travel north-east into Het's Oasis. Find Het's statue in the centre and dig on its north side.

column2: Willows north of the Necromancer's Tower
column3: Head south from East Ardougne towards the tower. Find three willows and dig on the north-east side of the group.
From Draynor Village follow the road towards the jail. Dig outside, to the north-east of the building.
Leave Yanille to the south. North-east of the crystal tree, look for three bushes arranged in a triangle and dig on their west side.
From the Karamja lodestone travel south to the gleaming wisp colony. Dig west of the rift, immediately north of the tree.

column2: South-west side of the Karamja divination colony
column3: Travel south from the Karamja lodestone to the gleaming wisps. Go around the rift to its south-west side.
Travel to Bedabin Camp in the Kharidian Desert. On the pond's north bank, dig in the gap between the two trees.

column2: Mine by the Nature altar, Karamja
column3: From Shilo Village head north towards the Nature altar. Enter the nearby mining area and dig in the middle.
From Yanille take the route south into Gu'Tanoth. Follow the bridges through the city and dig near the tree beyond the last bridge.
Enter the cave south of Gu'Tanoth's south-west corner. It takes you onto the island. Dig at the break in the stakes on the eastern edge.
Reach Crandor and follow the island to the runite rocks in the north-east. Dig five tiles east of the eastern rock.
Use the Port Sarim lodestone and charter a ship to the Shipyard. Walk west to G.L.O. Caranock's building and dig outside its east window.
Follow Arandar Pass to the red spiders' eggs. Dig one square north of the southernmost egg spawn.
Head to the plain rock mine in the Feldip Hills. Dig at the northernmost rockslide.
Go south through Mort Myre Swamp to the Nature Spirit's grotto. Dig behind the grotto tree.
Go north from the windmill to the river crossing south of the Champions' Guild. Dig beside the bridge.
Go west from Shilo Village to the coast. Cross the bridge to Cairn Isle, then follow the marker on the island.

column2: West side of the Desert Bandit Camp
column3: Use the Bandit Camp lodestone. Head to the western edge of the camp and dig between the shore and the cactus.
Go to the river crossing used to reach the Jungle Forester. Dig on the north side of the stepping stones.

column2: Lakes south-west of the Tree Gnome Stronghold
column3: Leave the stronghold towards its south-western lakes. Dig between the two eastern ponds.
Enter the swamp from Canifis. Go south past the two fishing spots to the next pond and look for the rotten tree.
From the Taverley lodestone go to the wheat field beside the dungeon entrance. Dig immediately south of the scarecrow.
Head south-west from the Taverley gate to the lake. Dig by the Lady of the Lake.

column2: Hemenster, north-east of the Fishing Guild
column3: From the Fishing Guild head north-east towards Hemenster. Dig on the marked ground south of the village.
Enter the Kharazi Jungle south of Shilo Village. Find the pool used during Legends' Quest and dig at its southern edge.

column2: Third pond in Mort Myre Swamp
column3: Enter through the swamp gate near Canifis. Follow the ponds south to the third and dig on the indicated bank.
Enter the Herblore Habitat and go to the south-west tree. Dig on its east side.
From Shilo Village enter the jungle and go to its south-western coast. Dig beside the corpse on the small peninsula.
Go to the south-west part of the stronghold and cross the bridge into the terrorbird pen. Leave by its eastern gate and dig near the water.
Use the Eagles' Peak lodestone. Go south-west to the path that climbs the mountain and dig at the bottom.
Bring a rope and reach the second waterfall island. Dig at the dead tree near the edge.

column2: Ice Mountain, south of the Oracle
column3: From Edgeville travel west to Ice Mountain. Find the pair of trees south of the Oracle and dig between them.
From Canifis head north-west towards the Slayer Tower. At the last torch before the fence, count six north and four east, then dig.

column2: Swamps north-west of the Grand Tree
column3: Go to the north-west side of the Tree Gnome Stronghold. Dig on the ground between the two swampy patches.
Use the Burthorpe lodestone. Find the building immediately south of the agility course and dig by the hay outside.
Use the Edgeville Dungeon route past the black demons. Climb the Air Obelisk ladder into the Wilderness and dig three tiles east of it.
Travel north from Edgeville to the dead trees around the bronze-arrow spawn. Dig just east of the arrows.
Use the Fremennik Province lodestone. Head into the forest east of Rellekka and dig two squares west of the swaying tree.
Travel to the summit of Trollheim. Dig immediately south of Mad Eadgar's cave entrance.
Take the mountain path to the Troll Stronghold. Dig on the south side of the entrance.
Go to the ruined buildings west of the Wilderness Bandit Camp. Enter the ruins and follow the marked tile.

column2: Lava pools north-east of the Boneyard
column3: Head north from the black salamanders to the three pools in level 22 Wilderness. Dig between the lava pools.

column2: Rock crab shore, north-east of Rellekka
column3: From Rellekka follow the coast north-east to the rock crabs. Dig on the seaweed east of the dock.

column2: Ruins north of the Graveyard of Shadows
column3: Reach the ruins in level 28 Wilderness. Find the steel platelegs and the trapdoor and dig between them.
Go to the central row of graves in the Forgotten Cemetery. Dig in front of the broken gravestone.
Start at the big bones in the area and head north towards the chaos dwarves. Use the marked square among the rocks.

column2: Moss giants west of Red Dragon Isle
column3: Find the pond among the moss giants in level 36 Wilderness. Dig on the north side of the water.
Head to the north-east part of the mine in level 36 Wilderness. Dig on the little rise.
Find the altar in level 38 Wilderness. Go outside to the south-west corner of its building and dig.
Travel to the fenced lesser demons in the Wilderness. Dig at the indicated tile inside the enclosure.
Take the boat to Miscellania. Find the mine and smithing area, then follow the path immediately south of it to its end.

column2: Runite rocks north of the Lava Maze
column3: Head to the runite rocks in level 46 Wilderness. Dig two tiles west of the eastern rock.
Reach the ruins and find the red pentagrams on the ground. Dig on the north-eastern pentagram.
Enter Rogues' Castle in level 53 Wilderness. Dig at the north-east corner inside the castle.
Use the Ardougne lever and go north from the keep, through the web. Continue to the marked ground by the bones.
Go around the back of the pirates' building. Dig one square west of the back door.

column2: West side of the Wilderness Agility Course
column3: Follow the western boundary of the course north. Dig near the fence at the northern end.

column2: Axe hut, north-east of the Mage Arena
column3: Go around the hut in level 56 Wilderness. Dig immediately west of its rear door.
From the Bandit Camp lodestone travel east and slightly north towards Pollnivneach. Dig at the pin on the surface map.
From Burthorpe head to the cave near the Death Plateau path. Enter and talk to Sabbot.
From Falador use the mine stairs by the Mining Guild area, or enter the mines at Ice Mountain. Follow the mine map to the chest.
Enter the Tree Gnome Stronghold. Look for Brimstail's cave in the south-west corner and speak to him inside.
Use the Falador lodestone, go south to the castle and cross the bridge. Talk to Squire Asrol in the courtyard.
From Edgeville go west to the monastery and speak to Abbot Langley.
Use the Port Sarim lodestone and enter Gerrant's fishing shop. Speak to Gerrant.

column2: Exam Centre, south of the Dig Site
column3: Head south from the Dig Site to the Exam Centre and speak to an examiner.
From the Barbarian Outpost head south to the house beside the falls. Climb upstairs and search the boxes.
Take Pirate Pete's boat to Braindeath Island. Follow the bridges and climb to the stagnant pool. Dig on its west side.
Go to the waterfront on the west side of the Worker district and speak to Hamid.
Find the rug merchant at Nardah. Go west to the large cactus and dig on its west side.
Go to the agility course inside the Tree Gnome Stronghold and speak to the trainer.

column2: Mine carts in the Dwarven Mine
column3: Enter the Dwarven Mine from Ice Mountain or Falador. Go east to the coal rocks and search the northern mine cart.

column2: Sorcerer's Tower, south of Seers' Village
column3: Travel south from Seers' Village to the Sorcerer's Tower. Go upstairs and search the north-wall bookcase.
From Draynor Village cross the bridge south to the tower. Search the south-west bookcase on the ground floor.
Enter the Grand Tree. On the level above the ground floor, speak to Heckel Funch.
Travel to Lletya, enter the general store and search its crate.
Climb down the rope in Karamja Volcano. Find the red spiders' eggs and dig on their spawn.
Travel east across the Kharidian Desert to Uzer. Look west of the Golem quest start and search the boxes.
Enter the sewers through the manhole east of Varrock Palace. Follow the tunnels to the moss giants and dig by the bubbling cauldron.

column2: Karamja gnome glider, Captain Klemfoodle's fire
column3: Travel to the gnome glider landing site on Karamja. Find Captain Klemfoodle beside the glider and dig on his campfire.
Enter the zoo in southern East Ardougne. Dig beside the torch between the scorpion and penguin pens.
Go north from the Barbarian Outpost towards the stepping stones. Dig on the westernmost small shell.
Enter the agility dungeon by Yanille. Use the Chaos altar route to the lower floor. Search the crates in the poison spider area.
Head south from East Ardougne to the tower. Go upstairs and search the drawers.

column2: Broken multicannon near the Coal Trucks
column3: Follow the track to the Dwarf Cannon site. Search the boxes against the outside north wall of the building with the broken cannon.
Use the Lumbridge lodestone and go west into the castle kitchen. Climb down the trapdoor. Search the crate in the south-east corner of the cellar.
Use the Bandit Camp lodestone. Enter the general store and search the crates inside.
Enter the workshop through the wall in the smithy west of the bank. Downstairs, search the crate east of the central hatch towards the air room.
Go north of Ardougne Castle to Jimmy Dazzler's house. Search the drawers on the left in its north-west corner.
Go to the witch's house and find its south window. Stand outside the window, south of the cauldron, and dig.
Go downstairs in Varrock west bank. Dig in front of the gate by the ruby ring.
From the Fremennik Province lodestone enter Rellekka and find Swensen the Navigator's house. Search the crate inside.
Follow the path up White Wolf Mountain to the glider and speak to its gnome pilot.
Use the Lumbridge lodestone and go west to the castle. Talk to Hans as he walks around the castle.
Enter Lumbridge Castle and climb one flight of stairs. Find the spinning wheel and search the drawers in that room.
From Varrock Square go north into the palace. Speak to Sir Prysin on the ground floor.
Go north-west from Lumbridge to the flour mill. Climb to the top and search the crate.
Find the fur stall in central Varrock and speak to Wilough nearby.
Use the Edgeville lodestone. Walk north to Oziach's armour shop and speak to him.
Find the two yews near the ruined building. Dig one tile east of the southern yew.
Take the monks' boat from Port Sarim to Entrana. Find the house with the glassblowing pipe and search the drawers on the south wall.
Go to the church east of the furnace. Climb its south-west ladder and search the crate in the tower.
Walk to the Port Sarim waterfront and speak to Captain Tobias.
Get the chest key from a monk at the monastery south of Ardougne. Search the chest in the chapel north of Varrock Museum.
Go to the tent beside the bank marker north-east of Het's Oasis. Speak to Jeed.
Obtain the key from a Zamorak monk at the temple south of Goblin Village. Search the drawers on the north-east side of Edgeville Monastery.
Kill a spellwisp outside the north-west side of the tower for its key. Take the key upstairs to the marked cupboard.
Head south from Brimhaven to Tai Bwo Wannai. Search the crates beneath the raised hut shown on the map.
From the Karamja lodestone head north to Lubufu on the shore. Search the crate by his fishing spot.
Get the key from a guard dog outside Handelmort Mansion. Cross to the tavern west of the river, go upstairs and search the drawers.
From Witchaven take Holgart's or Jeb's boat to the fishing platform. Search the crate inside the shack.
Reach Zanaris by fairy ring or the Lumbridge Swamp shed. Walk to the furnace in the north-west of the city and search the crates.
Head north from Het's Oasis to the arena. Go upstairs and search the bookcase in the north-east corner.
Use the Canifis lodestone. Enter the clothing shop and search its crates.
Look west of the Fishing Guild and south of the falls for Hadley's round building. Search the bales of hay inside.
Reach Karamja's banana plantation and follow the shore north to the dock with three rowboats. Search the middle crate.
Use the Burthorpe lodestone and go north to the houses. Enter the house at the pin and search its drawers.

column2: Seers' Village house south of the anvil
column3: Find the smithy in Seers' Village. Go to the house immediately south of it and check the drawers for the key clue.
Go south from West Ardougne to the battlefield. Search the crates outside its north-eastern building near the small obelisk.
Find the anvil building in Port Khazard. Stand immediately outside its door and dig.
Enter Sophanem and go to the pyramid. Search the crates south-west of the Pyramid Plunder entrance.
Go to the village well in Pollnivneach and dig alongside it.
Go to the Dig Site north of the Archaeology Guild. Descend the winch leading to Doug Deeping and search the sacks underground.
Enter the Ranging Guild and find the northern archery shop. Search the nearby crate.
Enter the ogre settlement south of Yanille. Find the rock cake stall and dig between the rocks in front.
Get a key from a pirate in the nearby bar. Go upstairs in the house with the cooking range and search the drawers.
Head south from Port Sarim towards the fairy ring on Mudskipper Point. Dig on the starfish south of the ring.
Enter the camp in the Kharidian Desert. Find the cart by the camel and search the crate to its south.
Follow the road east of Varrock towards the limestone quarry. At the Odd Old Man's camp dig in the western shed.
From the north gate go west to the bridge. Cross towards the south bank and dig by the spotted mushroom.
Walk east from the Brimhaven bar into the neighbouring house. Search its cupboard.
Get the key from a barbarian in Barbarian Village. At the Exam Centre search the chest in the southern room with the dragon head.
Go north-west from Seers' Village bank to the end of the coal tracks. Search the crate against the north wall.
Get the key from a market guard in Rellekka. Go upstairs in the Lighthouse and search the drawers by the bed.
Go south from East Ardougne to the monastery. Enter the monks' building and search the crates.

column2: House north of Yanille Wizards' Guild
column3: Get the key from the man downstairs in the house north of the guild. Climb the stairs and search the chest.
Walk west out of Witchaven to the temple entrance and descend. Search the chest against the first room's south wall.

column2: Broken cart west of the Outpost
column3: Head south-west of the Tree Gnome Stronghold to the Outpost. Go west to the damaged cart and search the crates.
Travel to the spiders in level 46 Wilderness. Find the sapphire spawn and dig beneath it.

column2: Quarry south of the Desert Bandit Camp
column3: Head south from the camp into the sandstone quarry. Find the wheelbarrow and dig by the marked side of it.
Enter the Observatory. Search the crate immediately north of the stairs leading down.
Pull the Wilderness lever in East Ardougne. Dig at the arrival spot in front of the return lever.
Get a key from an Ardougne guard. Go upstairs in Jerico's house east of the river and search the drawers.
Go to the Wilderness graveyard and look for the ground spawn of a crossbow. Pick it up and dig there.
Head south of the port towards the church near the ice dungeon. Dig just outside its west wall.
Take the boat to Miscellania and go east onto Etceteria. Dig at the crossroads.
Enter Shilo Village and go to the antiques shop. Search the bookcase on its west wall.
Enter Burthorpe Castle and go downstairs to the games room. Stand in the centre and perform the requested emote.

column2: Dwarven tunnel under White Wolf Mountain
column3: Take the underground passage between Taverley and Catherby. Find Captain Ninto in the dwarven bar.
Enter Keldagrim and cross to the eastern side. Find the sculptor's model Riki and speak to him.
Enter the Wizards' Guild in Yanille and go down to the cellar. Speak to Wizard Frumscone.
Reach Zanaris by fairy ring or the Lumbridge Swamp shed. Find Fairy Nuff north of the bank.
Go to Rantz in the eastern Feldip Hills. Enter his cave and speak to Fycie.
Reach the Tree Gnome Stronghold and enter the cave in the south-west corner. Talk to Brimstail.
Go to the goblin buildings just north-east of the Observatory. Search the crate in the group of three buildings.
Enter Yanille and find the building with the anvil. Dig at the south-east wall shown on the map.

column2: Picnic tables south of the Legends' Guild
column3: From the guild entrance walk south towards the picnic tables and dig two tiles south of the northern bench.
Enter West Ardougne and find the ruined building marked on the street map. Dig in its north-west corner.

column2: Clock Tower, south of East Ardougne
column3: Go to the Clock Tower south of Ardougne. Search the crate beside the nearby bridge.
Go west from Seers' Village and enter through the loose northern fence. Search the crate south of the hut.
Enter the Wilderness fortress west of the black unicorns. Search the crate in the courtyard.
Head north-east from Varrock towards the former Lumber Yard and follow the marker to the crate by the wall.
From the Khazard Battlefield follow the path towards Ourania. Dig immediately behind the chaos altar.

column2: South side of the Wizards' Tower
column3: From Draynor cross the bridge to the tower. Walk around to its south side and dig east of the rock.
Use the Seers' Village lodestone. Follow the coal tracks west to the river crossing. Dig just outside the door of Galahad's house.
Walk west through Rimmington towards the coast. Go to the west side of the chemist's house and dig.
Travel by boat to Miscellania and find the sign at the end of the path. Dig between the sign and the evergreen.
Go south from East Ardougne towards the Tower of Life. Find the large head by the road and dig to its south.
Go north of Falador's Party Room, outside the city wall. Dig west of the tree in the enclosure of standing stones.
Use the Falador lodestone and run north to the statue at the crossroads. Dig one tile south and three east of the statue.
Head south-east from Varrock to the mine. At the end of the path dig two tiles south-east of the dead tree.

column2: Road from Seers' Village to Rellekka
column3: Head north from the Seers' Village lodestone along the road towards Rellekka. Dig beside the bush at the bend.
Go west from the Crafting Guild onto the peninsula. At its tip, dig just west of the snape grass.
Go east of the Wilderness Agility Course to the craters. Find the large geyser and dig two tiles west.

column2: Crystal tree island west of Rellekka
column3: Look for the small island on the map west of Rellekka. Follow the branching path to the crystal tree and dig.
Enter the swamp south of Canifis. Find the mushroom shown on the map and dig four tiles west of it.
Go to the willow trees by the fishing spots. Dig between the southernmost willow and the small obelisk.

column2: River west of the Champions' Guild
column3: Go south-west from Varrock to the river near the guild. Dig three tiles east of the tree opposite the small island.
From the Seers' Village lodestone head south-west to the Ranging Guild, east of Hemenster. Enter the guild and search the large haystack by the southern fence.
